title: How do vaccines work? - Kelwalin Dhanasarnsombut
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】疫苗如何發揮作用？ - 凱爾瓦林‧達納桑松布 (Kelwalin Dhanasarnsombut)（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In 1796, the scientist Edward Jenner injected material from a cowpox virus into an eight-year-old boy
cues.en: In 1796, the scientist Edward Jenner injected material from a cowpox virus into an eight-year-old boy
cues.zh: 1796 年，科學家愛德華·簡納 將牛痘病毒中的物質 注射到八歲男童身上

cues.text: with a hunch that this would provide the protection needed to save people from deadly outbreaks of the related smallpox virus.
cues.en: with a hunch that this would provide the protection needed to save people from deadly outbreaks of the related smallpox virus.
cues.zh: 將牛痘病毒中的物質 注射到八歲男童身上 並有預感此舉將能為致命的天花疫情 提供預防方法 拯救民眾生命

cues.text: It was a success.
cues.en: It was a success.
cues.zh: 提供預防方法 拯救民眾生命 此法相當成功

cues.text: The eight-year-old was inoculated against the disease and this became the first ever vaccine.
cues.en: The eight-year-old was inoculated against the disease and this became the first ever vaccine.
cues.zh: 這名接受接種的八歲男童能抵禦天花 世界首個疫苗於焉問世

cues.text: But why did it work?
cues.en: But why did it work?
cues.zh: 但這背後的原理為何？

cues.text: To understand how vaccines function, we need to know how the immune system defends us against contagious diseases
cues.en: To understand how vaccines function, we need to know how the immune system defends us against contagious diseases
cues.zh: 但這背後的原理為何？ 想知道疫苗原理 就得先了解人體免疫系統 是如何在第一時間 抵抗傳染疾病

cues.text: in the first place.
cues.en: in the first place.
cues.zh: 抵抗傳染疾病 當遭受外來病菌侵襲時

cues.text: When foreign microbes invade us, the immune system triggers a series of responses
cues.en: When foreign microbes invade us, the immune system triggers a series of responses
cues.zh: 抵抗傳染疾病 當遭受外來病菌侵襲時 免疫系統會啟動一系列反應

cues.text: in an attempt to identify and remove them from our bodies.
cues.en: in an attempt to identify and remove them from our bodies.
cues.zh: 免疫系統會啟動一系列反應 試圖辨識並將這些病菌趕出體外

cues.text: The signs that this immune response is working are the coughing, sneezing, inflammation and fever we experience,
cues.en: The signs that this immune response is working are the coughing, sneezing, inflammation and fever we experience,
cues.zh: 免疫反應的徵兆包括 我們經歷到的咳嗽 打噴嚏、發炎及發燒

cues.text: which work to trap, deter and rid the body of threatening things, like bacteria.
cues.en: which work to trap, deter and rid the body of threatening things, like bacteria.
cues.zh: 這都是為了將危害物質如細菌等 包圍、遏止並趕出體外

cues.text: These innate immune responses also trigger our second line of defense,
cues.en: These innate immune responses also trigger our second line of defense,
cues.zh: 這都是為了將危害物質如細菌等 包圍、遏止並趕出體外 此先天免疫反應也會誘發第二道防線

cues.text: called adaptive immunity.
cues.en: called adaptive immunity.
cues.zh: 此先天免疫反應也會誘發第二道防線 稱之為後天性免疫

cues.text: Special cells called B cells and T cells are recruited to fight microbes,
cues.en: Special cells called B cells and T cells are recruited to fight microbes,
cues.zh: 特殊的 B 細胞及 T 細胞 會被徵招來抵抗病菌 並記錄下病原菌資訊

cues.text: and also record information about them, creating a memory of what the invaders look like,
cues.en: and also record information about them, creating a memory of what the invaders look like,
cues.zh: 特殊的 B 細胞及 T 細胞 會被徵招來抵抗病菌 並記錄下病原菌資訊 以存檔瞭解侵略者的外觀 及最佳抵禦方式

cues.text: and how best to fight them.
cues.en: and how best to fight them.
cues.zh: 及最佳抵禦方式 下次再碰上同樣病原體時

cues.text: This know-how becomes handy if the same pathogen invades the body again.
cues.en: This know-how becomes handy if the same pathogen invades the body again.
cues.zh: 下次再碰上同樣病原體時 這些實戰知識就能立即拿來使用

cues.text: But despite this smart response, there's still a risk involved.
cues.en: But despite this smart response, there's still a risk involved.
cues.zh: 這些實戰知識就能立即拿來使用 但儘管免疫反應如此精巧 還是有風險存在

cues.text: The body takes time to learn how to respond to pathogens and to build up these defenses.
cues.en: The body takes time to learn how to respond to pathogens and to build up these defenses.
cues.zh: 因為身體需要花時間 才能瞭解如何因應病菌 及建立防禦措施 即便如此

cues.text: And even then, if a body is too weak or young to fight back when it's invaded,
cues.en: And even then, if a body is too weak or young to fight back when it's invaded,
cues.zh: 即便如此 若在發育未臻成熟或體衰時得病 就無法有效抵抗疾病

cues.text: it might face very serious risk if the pathogen is particularly severe.
cues.en: it might face very serious risk if the pathogen is particularly severe.
cues.zh: 因此若碰上特別棘手的病菌時 就可能面臨非常嚴重的危險

cues.text: But what if we could prepare the body's immune response, readying it before someone even got ill?
cues.en: But what if we could prepare the body's immune response, readying it before someone even got ill?
cues.zh: 因此若碰上特別棘手的病菌時 就可能面臨非常嚴重的危險 但要是能在第一次得病前 就讓免疫系統做好對抗疾病的準備呢？

cues.text: This is where vaccines come in.
cues.en: This is where vaccines come in.
cues.zh: 這就是疫苗的由來

cues.text: Using the same principles that the body uses to defend itself,
cues.en: Using the same principles that the body uses to defend itself,
cues.zh: 這就是疫苗的由來 原理就跟身體的自我防禦一樣 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統

cues.text: scientists use vaccines to trigger the body's adaptive immune system,
cues.en: scientists use vaccines to trigger the body's adaptive immune system,
cues.zh: 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中

cues.text: without exposing humans to the full strength disease.
cues.en: without exposing humans to the full strength disease.
cues.zh: 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中

cues.text: This has resulted in many vaccines, which each work uniquely,
cues.en: This has resulted in many vaccines, which each work uniquely,
cues.zh: 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中 於是許多疫苗問世 這些疫苗可被分成多種類別 每個都有其獨特的作用方式

cues.text: separated into many different types.
cues.en: separated into many different types.
cues.zh: 每個都有其獨特的作用方式 首先 有活性減毒疫苗

cues.text: First, we have live attenuated vaccines.
cues.en: First, we have live attenuated vaccines.
cues.zh: 首先 有活性減毒疫苗 由已被削減致病性的活體病菌所製成

cues.text: These are made of the pathogen itself but a much weaker and tamer version.
cues.en: These are made of the pathogen itself but a much weaker and tamer version.
cues.zh: 由已被削減致病性的活體病菌所製成 另外還有非活性疫苗 此疫苗中的病原菌已全被殺死

cues.text: Next, we have inactive vaccines, in which the pathogens have been killed.
cues.en: Next, we have inactive vaccines, in which the pathogens have been killed.
cues.zh: 另外還有非活性疫苗 此疫苗中的病原菌已全被殺死 此兩種疫苗中含有 已被弱化或無活性病菌

cues.text: The weakening and inactivation in both types of vaccine ensures that pathogens don't develop into the full blown disease.
cues.en: The weakening and inactivation in both types of vaccine ensures that pathogens don't develop into the full blown disease.
cues.zh: 此兩種疫苗中含有 已被弱化或無活性病菌 可確保該病原菌 不會在人體內發展成真正的疾病 但卻又能像疾病一樣 誘發免疫反應

cues.text: But just like a disease, they trigger an immune response,
cues.en: But just like a disease, they trigger an immune response,
cues.zh: 但卻又能像疾病一樣 誘發免疫反應 為目標病菌建立檔案

cues.text: teaching the body to recognize an attack by making a profile of pathogens in preparation.
cues.en: teaching the body to recognize an attack by making a profile of pathogens in preparation.
cues.zh: 為目標病菌建立檔案 教導身體辨識該病菌的侵襲 活性減毒疫苗的缺點是難以製備

cues.text: The downside is that live attenuated vaccines can be difficult to make,
cues.en: The downside is that live attenuated vaccines can be difficult to make,
cues.zh: 活性減毒疫苗的缺點是難以製備 且因內含活性相當強大的病菌

cues.text: and because they're live and quite powerful, people with weaker immune systems can't have them,
cues.en: and because they're live and quite powerful, people with weaker immune systems can't have them,
cues.zh: 且因內含活性相當強大的病菌 免疫系統弱的人並不適合接受接種 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力

cues.text: while inactive vaccines don't create long-lasting immunity.
cues.en: while inactive vaccines don't create long-lasting immunity.
cues.zh: 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力

cues.text: Another type, the subunit vaccine, is only made from one part of the pathogen, called an antigen,
cues.en: Another type, the subunit vaccine, is only made from one part of the pathogen, called an antigen,
cues.zh: 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力 另一種疫苗型別： 次單位疫苗 這種疫苗只含部分病原體 稱之為抗原

cues.text: the ingredient that actually triggers the immune response.
cues.en: the ingredient that actually triggers the immune response.
cues.zh: 這種疫苗只含部分病原體 稱之為抗原 也是真正誘發免疫反應的成分 而進一步分離出抗原中的特定成分

cues.text: By even further isolating specific components of antigens, like proteins or polysaccharides,
cues.en: By even further isolating specific components of antigens, like proteins or polysaccharides,
cues.zh: 而進一步分離出抗原中的特定成分 如蛋白質或多醣

cues.text: these vaccines can prompt specific responses.
cues.en: these vaccines can prompt specific responses.
cues.zh: 如蛋白質或多醣 這型別疫苗可立即促使特定反應

cues.text: Scientists are now building a whole new range of vaccines
cues.en: Scientists are now building a whole new range of vaccines
cues.zh: 這型別疫苗可立即促使特定反應 科學家現已著手建立新的疫苗系列

cues.text: called DNA vaccines.
cues.en: called DNA vaccines.
cues.zh: 科學家現已著手建立新的疫苗系列 稱之為 DNA 疫苗

cues.text: For this variety, they isolate the very genes that make the specific antigens
cues.en: For this variety, they isolate the very genes that make the specific antigens
cues.zh: 稱之為 DNA 疫苗 為使身體對特定病菌產生免疫反應 他們分離出目標抗原的基因

cues.text: the body needs to trigger its immune response to specific pathogens.
cues.en: the body needs to trigger its immune response to specific pathogens.
cues.zh: 他們分離出目標抗原的基因 而人體在接受注射後

cues.text: When injected into the human body, those genes instruct cells in the body to make the antigens.
cues.en: When injected into the human body, those genes instruct cells in the body to make the antigens.
cues.zh: 而人體在接受注射後 疫苗內的基因 會指示體內細胞製造抗原 這會引發更強大的免疫反應

cues.text: This causes a stronger immune response, and prepares the body for any future threats,
cues.en: This causes a stronger immune response, and prepares the body for any future threats,
cues.zh: 這會引發更強大的免疫反應 讓身體準備好對抗任何潛在威脅

cues.text: and because the vaccine only includes specific genetic material, it doesn't contain any other ingredients from the rest of the pathogen
cues.en: and because the vaccine only includes specific genetic material, it doesn't contain any other ingredients from the rest of the pathogen
cues.zh: 讓身體準備好對抗任何潛在威脅 此型別疫苗僅由特定基因物質組成 因此不含病原菌其它可能

cues.text: that could develop into the disease and harm the patient.
cues.en: that could develop into the disease and harm the patient.
cues.zh: 因此不含病原菌其它可能 致病並危害病人健康的物質

cues.text: If these vaccines become a success, we might be able to build more effective treatments
cues.en: If these vaccines become a success, we might be able to build more effective treatments
cues.zh: 致病並危害病人健康的物質 若能研發成功 就可能在幾年內 建立更有效的治療方法

cues.text: for invasive pathogens in years to come.
cues.en: for invasive pathogens in years to come.
cues.zh: 就可能在幾年內 建立更有效的治療方法 來對抗侵入性病菌的感染

cues.text: Just like Edward Jenner's amazing discovery spurred on modern medicine all those decades ago,
cues.en: Just like Edward Jenner's amazing discovery spurred on modern medicine all those decades ago,
cues.zh: 來對抗侵入性病菌的感染 正如簡納當年的驚人發現 促成過去數十年的醫學進步

cues.text: continuing the development of vaccines might even allow us to treat diseases like HIV,
cues.en: continuing the development of vaccines might even allow us to treat diseases like HIV,
cues.zh: 隨著疫苗技術的持續發展 也許有天也能找到治療愛滋病 瘧疾

cues.text: malaria, or Ebola, one day.
cues.en: malaria, or Ebola, one day.
cues.zh: 也許有天也能找到治療愛滋病 瘧疾 或伊波拉的方法
